contexto.Misión 3 «Emergència ambiental i climàti: Mission 3 «Emergència ambiental i climàtica». The plan explicitly sets 2005 as the base year.
contexto.Misión 8 «Vitalitat cultural». El propio: Mission 8 «Vitalitat cultural». The plan itself notes, as a prior lever, the lack of specific, territorialised cultural data.
contexto.Misión 1 «Economia innovadora i inclusiv: Mission 1 «Economia innovadora i inclusiva». Stated baseline: Catalan private spending 0.86% (2019), compared with 2.08% in the Basque Country and a European average of 1.53%. The plan justifies 1.2% as achievable.
Mission 2 «Nivells de renda suficients». No figure: the commitment is institutional. Stated levers: aligning public procurement with the reference wage, and revaluing feminised precarious sectors. Context: women's average wage €27,869 versus €34,261 for men (−18.7%, 2019).
contexto.Misión 4 «Mobilitat sostenible i segura»: Mission 4 «Mobilitat sostenible i segura». Stated context: in 2019, 34% of everyday trips were made by private vehicle (EMEF/IERMB), and the Pla Director de Mobilitat 2020-2025 only projected a 3% shift by 2025, which is why the plan describes the 10% target as «prou ambiciós» (ambitious enough).
contexto.Misión 5 «Alimentació saludable». Línea: Mission 5 «Alimentació saludable». Baseline: 45.8% of the shopping basket is local produce, according to a 2022 PRODECA survey of over 500 people aged 25-65. The plan itself flags the limitations of this indicator.
contexto.Misión 6 «Cohesió territorial». Define r: Mission 6 «Cohesió territorial». Defines low income as income per consumption unit below 60% of the Spanish average, a threshold the IERMB considers well suited to the metropolitan reality.
contexto.Misión 7 «Habitatge adequat». Referencia: Mission 7 «Habitatge adequat». Reference: the UN threshold, which considers housing affordable when a household spends less than 30% of its income on it. Context: the social rental stock accounts for 1.8% of the metropolitan total, well below the European average.
